title: setDesiredAPY commit is mempool-visible; stakers front-run to capture rate-change delta
description: The commit branch of setDesiredAPY is a public, mempool-visible tx with a known signature. SYMBOLIC-005 PASS confirms the two-step gate is delay-only — it provides exactly the 100-block window the spec advertises and nothing more. MEV bots can stake just before the commit lands and exit shortly after the new rate takes effect, capturing a disproportionate share of the post-commit accrual.
impact: Sophisticated mempool-watching stakers capture a disproportionate share of post-commit accrual at the expense of passive stakers. No direct fund theft. The two-step gate's design intent (mitigate MEV) is not realized; it is a delay-only gate.
attackPath: MEV bot front-runs with stake(big_amount); debt anchors at OLD acc.
Commit tx lands; new rate applies prospectively.
Bot accrues at higher rate; eventually claims + withdraws.
likelihood: high when an honest owner changes APY; rational MEV behavior
assumptions: Public mempool; APY rate changes occur
recommendation: Route the commit tx through a private mempool (e.g., Flashbots Protect) as operational practice. For an on-chain mitigation, pair the magnitude-cap recommendation in C-03 with a rate-of-change cap (max |bps_new - bps_old| per epoch) to bound the MEV size.

symbolic: SYMBOLIC-005 PASS — confirms the gate is delay-only, providing no MEV protection (positive proof)

classifierRationale: Generic front-running of admin action; C4 routes this category to QA. SYMBOLIC-005 confirms gate is delay-only by design.
